description: Creates the real order. Requires a confirm_token minted by validate_order. Returns the payment wallet address, exact crypto amount, 30-minute expiry, and an order-status URL. The purchased code/QR is emailed by Cryptorefills to the buyer — it is never returned here.

confirm_token.description: One-time token returned by validate_order (valid 10 minutes)

full_name.description: Buyer full legal name — only if a previous attempt returned FULLNAME_MISSING

name: create_order

error.description: Present on failure: KYC_MISSING | FULLNAME_MISSING | PHONE_MISSING | CONFIRM_TOKEN_*

network.description: Exact network — funds sent elsewhere are lost

pay_to_address.description: Wallet address to send funds to

qr_url.description: QR code PNG of the address

state.description: CREATED | WAITING_FOR_PAYMENT | PARTIAL | COMPLETED | CANCELED | EXPIRED

title: Place order
